source_license.modifications: Original PNG unchanged. Union Solid line RGB255,193,37 and Dashed line RGB128,0,255 ->foreground1; other known classes->0; unknown, Blurred area and Rain dirt->ignore255. No expected outline, wear ratio, or synthetic labels.

duplicate_policy: Union exact image SHA256 and grayscale32x32 DCT64 pHash Hamming<=6; remove ALL members of connected clusters crossing partitions. Shared routes or physical road objects cannot be ruled out by this check.
integrity: Every selected original image/label byte count and MD5 matches the official extracted S3 object listing ETag. Original full-tar checksums are not claimed.
limitation: Publisher semantic solid/dashed line classes support pixel segmentation research, not measured remaining-paint wear, expected outline, R-MAE, reflectivity or road safety acceptance. Dates/recordings differ; GPS-disjoint routes are not verified. No synthetic outline labels and no RTK split/holdout changes.
